newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambican president sacks interior minister - radio.
newsitem.headline: Mozambican president sacks interior minister - radio.

text.p: Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano has dismissed controversial Interior Minister Manuel Antonio, Radio Mozambique reported on Friday.
The radio said he would be replaced by Almerinho Manhenje, who will also retain his current post as minister in the presidency for defence and security affairs.
Chissano also sacked the interior vice-minister, Edmundo Carlos Alberto.
The radio did not give reasons for the sackings, but Antonio has been strongly criticised for failing to curb crime and address complaints of ill-treatment of awaiting-trial prisoners.
